findings.claim_text: Punit Shah of Anthropic's Frontier Red Team posted on 2026-10-19 that "~650 projects applied", "114 accepted", and "77 critical and 803 high model-rated findings reported", with the parenthetical "we haven't scanned all projects yet" [^5].
Mythos called 8 of them Critical; "One of the eight Critical ratings held" [^13].
By our arithmetic that is 516 of 6,157, or 8.4%, as of 2026-10-02 [^9].
